subject: Barlas origin lore as told by Arlequino

facts.origin: Barlas split from another rebellious steppe lineage
facts.setting: vast steppe; powerful empire to the north
facts.imperial_policy: approximately every 5 years imperial troops entered the steppe to reduce/control tribal population by killing part of it
facts.captured_chief: chief of the parent lineage was taken and executed, reportedly nailed to a wooden donkey
facts.oath: the chief swore that his descendants would avenge him
facts.revenge: about 100 years later the steppe tribes were forcibly united and went to war against the empire
facts.outcome: the empire, despite a multimillion population and divine self-image, was destroyed, plundered and its people subjugated by those it had not regarded as fully human
